description: Finds who owns a US property from its street address, given as full_address or as street, city, state and zip. Returns the property details; with contact_audience=owners it also returns the owners with their names, phones (with DNC flags) and emails. Contacts are left out unless contact_audience is set. Needs a connected DealMachine account with paid access. A matched property costs one property credit and returned contacts cost people credits; nothing is charged when no property matches. To get just the owners and their contact info, set anchor=people (and require_phone=true to skip owners without a phone): only the owners cost credits, one people credit each, unless fields asks for a paid property field.

anchor.description: `people` returns the owners as the results: each owner costs one people credit and the property comes back with only its ID, address and location for no property credit, unless fields asks for a paid property field. Defaults contact_audience to owners. `properties` (the default) returns the property details.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts

fields.description: DealMachine property field IDs to include in results

full_address.description: Complete address string (e.g. "123 Main St, Austin, TX 78701"), as an alternative to the parsed address fields

require_phone.description: With anchor=people, leaves out (and does not charge) owners without a phone

street.description: Street address component only (e.g. "123 Main St"); separate city, state, and ZIP fields are available

name: dealmachine_enrich_address
